# Startup

Ideas for reducing the wait before the first batch or training step. Startup and steady-state performance are separate; keep process safety, sample coverage and restart behavior intact.

Choose the topic whose symptoms match the startup bottleneck. Open only that reference for technique entries and their process-safety, resource and data-semantics guards.

[Catalog index](../technique_catalog.md)

## Worker launch and imports

- [Worker launch and imports](startup/worker_launch_and_imports.md): serial worker starts, repeated CPU imports, bootstrap re-imports and inherited thread-lock failures.

## Startup payload loading

- [Startup payload loading](startup/startup_payload_loading.md): serialized mappings or record graphs, serial manifest decoding and eager evaluation materialization.

## Loader graph initialization

- [Loader graph initialization](startup/loader_graph_initialization.md): duplicate native wrappers, repeated transform-module scripting and dynamic callable capture during bootstrap.
